name: ParcelaShow – Parcelamento sem Juros, Tabela de Parcelas e Preço à Vista for WooCommerce
author: wooglobalapps

sections.description:
In Brazil and across Latin America shoppers decide by the installment, not by the price: “12x de R$ 20,83 sem juros”, “R$ 224,91 à vista no Pix”, “12 meses sin intereses”. ParcelaShow shows those offers everywhere in your WooCommerce store, using the same rules as your payment gateway.

ParcelaShow is an independent plugin developed by WooGlobal Apps. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WooCommerce / Automattic or the Central Bank of Brazil (Banco Central do Brasil), owner of the Pix brand. “Pix” is mentioned only to describe a payment method your store may offer.

Features

  • Best installment below the price: “12x of $20.83 interest-free” on the product page, shop and category pages, related products and product blocks.
  • Cash / Pix price: “$224.91 for cash payment (10% off)”.
  • Full installment table on the product page, inside an accessible toggle (native details/summary, keyboard and screen reader friendly).
  • Interest-free and with-interest installments: choose how many installments are interest-free and a monthly compound interest rate for the others (Price / French amortization formula: PMT = PV × i / (1 − (1 + i)^−n)).
  • Minimum installment value: options smaller than the minimum are not offered.
  • Variable products: installments and table update instantly when the customer picks a variation.
  • Cart and checkout: best installment and cash price for the order total, in the classic cart/checkout and in the Cart and Checkout blocks (updated live when the cart changes).
  • Block themes: works with the Product Price block and the single product block template, without duplicated output.
  • Shortcode [parcelashow] to place the offer anywhere.
  • Any currency and language: amounts use your WooCommerce currency settings, and every text is a template with placeholders: {count} {value} {total} {price} {discount}.
  • Compatible with HPOS and the Cart/Checkout blocks. Translation ready. No external requests, no tracking.
  • Help screen with setup tips, a welcome screen after activation and optional links to free setup help.

Em português

ParcelaShow mostra o parcelamento sem juros, a tabela completa de parcelas e o preço à vista com desconto (por exemplo “R$ 224,91 à vista no Pix”) em toda a sua loja WooCommerce: página do produto, vitrine e categorias, carrinho e checkout (clássico e em blocos). Você informa as mesmas condições do seu meio de pagamento: número máximo de parcelas, parcelas sem juros, taxa de juros mensal, parcela mínima e desconto à vista.

  • Melhor parcela abaixo do preço: “12x de R$ 20,83 sem juros”.
  • Tabela de parcelas com e sem juros (fórmula Price), acessível e recolhível.
  • Preço à vista / Pix com desconto: apenas exibição, os preços da loja não são alterados.
  • Produtos variáveis, blocos do carrinho e do checkout, temas de blocos e shortcode [parcelashow].
  • Gratuito, sem requisições externas e sem rastreamento.

O ParcelaShow é um plugin independente da WooGlobal Apps, sem vínculo com o WooCommerce / Automattic ou com o Banco Central do Brasil (titular da marca Pix).

Support & free setup

Questions and bug reports: use the support forum.

If you prefer, we install and configure ParcelaShow on your store for free. The Help and Hire us tabs under WooCommerce → ParcelaShow and the plugin row on the Plugins screen have links that open WhatsApp with a message containing only the plugin name and version, and a link to our website with optional paid services (for example real card installments with your payment gateway or product page design).

These are plain links: nothing is sent unless you click them and send the message yourself. ParcelaShow works fully without them: every feature is free and nothing is locked. A single dismissible notice (Dashboard and Plugins screens only, 7 days after activation) offers the same help and a link to rate the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the parcelashow folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from Plugins → Add New.
  3. Activate ParcelaShow.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → ParcelaShow and set the same conditions offered by your payment gateway: maximum installments, interest-free installments, monthly interest rate, minimum installment and cash discount.
sections.faq:
Is ParcelaShow an official WooCommerce or Pix plugin?

No. ParcelaShow is an independent plugin. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WooCommerce / Automattic or the Central Bank of Brazil (owner of the Pix brand).

Does ParcelaShow change my prices or charge interest?

No. ParcelaShow only displays information. It never changes product prices, cart totals, order totals or what the payment gateway charges. Configure the installment rules and the cash discount to match your payment gateway, and apply the real cash discount in your payment method or with a coupon.

How is the interest calculated?

Installments up to the “interest-free” limit split the price evenly. Above it, the fixed monthly installment of the Price system (Tabela Price) is used: PMT = PV × i / (1 − (1 + i)^−n), where i is the monthly rate. Example: 1,000 in 12 installments at 1.99% per month = 94.50 per month.

Which placeholders can I use?

{count} number of installments, {value} installment amount, {total} total paid, {price} price (in the cash text: the discounted price) and {discount} discount percentage.

How do I use the shortcode?

[parcelashow] shows the summary and the table for the current product. Use [parcelashow id="123"] for another product, and summary="no" or table="no" to hide a part.

Does it work with block themes?

Yes. The offer is added to the product price HTML, so it appears in the Product Price block and in classic templates. On the single product template the installment table is added once, right after the main price.

Where does it appear in the Cart and Checkout blocks?

Below the Cart or Checkout block, and it follows the cart total as the customer changes quantities, shipping or coupons.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Plugin name, tags and description now use the Portuguese terms Brazilian stores search for (parcelamento sem juros, tabela de parcelas, preço à vista). No functional changes.

1.0.0

  • First release: best installment, installment table and cash/Pix price on product, shop, cart and checkout pages, with block support and the [parcelashow] shortcode.
  • Welcome screen, Help tab with setup tips, optional free setup and Hire us links.
